mechanics.claim: Damaging basic attacks and abilities against enemy champions apply a mark storing a portion of post-mitigation damage dealt.
mechanics.quote: His damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against enemy champions apply a mark that stores a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}} dealt

mechanics.claim: Recast ends Spirit Form and detonates all marks, dealing true damage equal to the amount stored on each champion.
mechanics.quote: consuming the marks on each champion to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} equal to the total amount of damage stored against each of them

mechanics.claim: The mark does not store damage from items, runes, and summoner spells, except damage that inherits champion source (e.g. Cut Down, Dead Man's Plate).
mechanics.quote: The marks do not store damage from [[item]]s, [[rune]]s and [[summoner spell]]s, excluding damage that inherits champion source

mechanics.claim: The mark also automatically detonates without recasting when the marked champion dies or enters resurrection.
mechanics.quote: The mark also automatically detonates without '''Yone''' having to recast when the marked champion dies or enters {{tip|resurrection}}

mechanics.claim: Detonation damage cannot be dodged by becoming untargetable.
mechanics.quote: The detonation damage cannot be dodged by becoming {{tip|untargetable}}

mechanics.claim: Marks do not store damage dealt to shields.
mechanics.quote: The marks will not store damage dealt to {{tip|shield|shields}}

mechanics.claim: Activation resets Yone's current sword (Way of the Hunter) stance state.
mechanics.quote: Activation resets ''{{ais|Way of the Hunter|Yone}}'' current sword state

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the recast (post-effect), not on initial cast.
Yone becomes ghosted and gains bonus movement speed during Spirit Form.
